summary.text: Jeff Olsommer is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 139 who has served since May 21, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is president of an insurance group and has served on the Sterling Township Board of Supervisors.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Olsommer graduated from Western Wayne High School in 1986 and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from East Stroudsburg University of Pennsylvania in 1990.
His career experience includes working as president of Olsommer Clarke Insurance Group, Inc.
He became a member of the Sterling Township Board of Supervisors in 2014.
Olsommer assumed office on May 21, 2024, succeeding Joseph Adams.
